opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant search + recipe search + note
opportunities.description: For a cuisine/area, find a top restaurant on OpenTable, find a matching recipe on Allrecipes, and save a combined 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note.
steps: Search OpenTable for cuisine+area and open the top restaurant
Search Allrecipes for the dish and open the top recipe
Type 'Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, <area>) or cook <recipe> (<time>)' and press Enter

instances.values: Italian Islington / lasagna -> Terra Rossa, Creamy Chicken Lasagna
Thai Soho / pad thai -> Thai Tho, Pad Thai
Indian Shoreditch / chicken tikka masala -> SPICE SLICE, Chicken Tikka Masala

opportunities.name: Stopover hotel search + note
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a city and weekend dates, open the top hotel, look up the city on Wikipedia, and save a 'Stopover' note with hotel, price and population.
steps: Search Wikipedia for the city for population/landmark
Enter destination on Booking.com and choose suggestion
Select check-in and check-out dates and click Search

opportunities.name: Time zone + weather call email draft
opportunities.description: For a city, check the local time on timeanddate and the 10-day forecast on Weather.com, then draft an email to family announcing a call with the time and forecast, and discard it.
steps: Search the city on timeanddate and open its result
Search the city in Weather.com location box and select it
In mail, enter To, Subject 'Call with <person> on <day>', and body with local time, offset and forecast
